DLG-SC-LOC-033-17-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-17-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご入浴の前にお荷物の案内をご覧ください。大きなおかばんをお持ちですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-17-001-SHARED-01.translation: Before bathing, please read the luggage information. You have a large bag with you.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-17-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-17-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 旅行用のかばんがロッカーに入るか心配なので、先に大きさを確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-17-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 旅行用かばんがロッカーに入るか利用前に確かめたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-17-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am worried my travel bag may not fit in a locker, so I would like to check the size first.
DLG-SC-LOC-033-17-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you want to check whether your travel bag fits in a locker before using the facilities. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-17-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-17-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ロッカーの見本がありますので、扉が閉まるか無理に押し込まずに確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-17-001-SHARED-03.translation: There is a sample locker. Please check whether the door closes without forcing your bag inside.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-17-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-17-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この幅だと入らないので、脱衣所の床に置いておくことはできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-17-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: ロッカーに入らないかばんを脱衣所の床へ置けるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-17-001-SHARED-04.translation: It will not fit at this width. Can I leave it on the changing-room floor?
DLG-SC-LOC-033-17-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether a bag that does not fit in the locker can be left on the changing-room floor. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-17-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-17-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 通行の妨げになる置き方は避けてください。ほかに預ける方法があるか受付へ確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-17-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please avoid placing it where it would obstruct people. Let us ask reception whether there is another way to store it.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-17-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-17-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 預かりがなければ、外で待っている同行者に渡してから利用します。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-17-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 預かりがなければ外の同行者にかばんを渡す代案を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-17-001-SHARED-06.translation: If there is no storage service, I will give it to my companion waiting outside before using the facilities.
DLG-SC-LOC-033-17-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Offer the alternative of giving the bag to your companion outside if there is no storage service. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-17-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-17-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その方法もありますね。貴重品の扱いは別に考え、案内に従って保管してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-17-001-SHARED-07.translation: That is another option. Please consider valuables separately and store them according to the instructions.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-17-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-17-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 財布は自分で保管したいので、小さいロッカーの施錠の仕方も聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-17-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 財布を保管する小型ロッカーの施錠操作を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-17-001-SHARED-08.translation: I would like to keep my wallet myself, so I also want to ask how to lock a small locker.
DLG-SC-LOC-033-17-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask how to lock the small locker where you will store your wallet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-17-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-17-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 見本で鍵の操作を説明します。閉めたあとは、扉が開かないか確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-17-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will explain the key operation using the sample. After locking it, check that the door does not open.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-17-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-17-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 大きいかばんは同行者に渡し、財布を収納して鍵をかけてから浴室へ進みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-17-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 大きな荷物を同行者へ渡し財布を施錠してから入浴する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-17-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will give the large bag to my companion, put away my wallet, and lock the locker before going into the bathing area.
DLG-SC-LOC-033-17-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Give your large bag to your companion and lock away your wallet before bathing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-17-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-17-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お荷物の確認が済んでからご利用ください。どうぞ、ごゆっくりお過ごしください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-17-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please use the facilities after you have sorted out your luggage. Enjoy your time here.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-18-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-18-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お荷物をお預けになるご希望ですね。ご予約の日付を確認させてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-18-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to leave your luggage with us. Please let me check your reservation date.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-18-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-18-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 今夜泊まるつもりで早く着いたので、部屋に入る前にこの荷物を預けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-18-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 今夜の宿泊と思い込み早着して荷物を預けたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-18-001-SHARED-02.translation: I arrived early because I thought I was staying tonight. I would like to leave this luggage before going into my room.
DLG-SC-LOC-033-18-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you arrived early assuming your stay was tonight and want to leave your luggage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-18-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-18-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この予約画面では到着日が明日となっています。ご予約の日をもう一度ご確認いただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-18-001-SHARED-03.translation: The arrival date on this reservation screen is tomorrow. Could you check your booking date again?

DLG-SC-LOC-033-18-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-18-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 本当ですね、今日の日付で予約したつもりでしたが、画面は一日先になっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-18-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 予約画面の到着日が一日先になっている誤りに気づく。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-18-001-SHARED-04.translation: You are right. I thought I had booked for today, but the screen shows one day later.
DLG-SC-LOC-033-18-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Notice that the arrival date on the reservation screen is mistakenly one day later. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-18-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-18-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今日の宿泊へ変更できるか、空き状況と予約の条件を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-18-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check availability and the booking conditions to see whether we can change your stay to today.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-18-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-18-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 変更の料金がわかるまでは手続きを進めず、結果を聞いてから判断したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-18-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 変更料金を聞くまで日付変更手続きを進めないよう依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-18-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do not proceed until I know the change fee. I would like to hear the result and then decide.
DLG-SC-LOC-033-18-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask them not to proceed with the date change until you hear the change fee. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-18-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-18-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 承知しました。お荷物の預かりについても、今日のご利用条件を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-18-001-SHARED-07.translation: Understood. I will also check today's conditions for luggage storage.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-18-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-18-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 部屋の変更と荷物の預かりは別に確認するのですね、どちらも説明を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-18-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 宿泊変更と荷物預かりの条件を別々に確認すると理解を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-18-001-SHARED-08.translation: So the room change and luggage storage will be checked separately. I will wait for an explanation of both.
DLG-SC-LOC-033-18-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show that you understand the stay change and luggage-storage conditions will be checked separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-18-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-18-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、確認が済むまでこちらでお待ちください。荷物はお手元に置いていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-18-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Please wait here until we have checked. Could you keep your luggage with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-033-18-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-18-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 荷物を横に置いて待ちますので、変更できない場合もそのまま教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-18-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 荷物を手元で保管して待ち変更不可でも知らせてもらう。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-18-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will wait with the luggage beside me. Please also tell me directly if the change is not possible.
DLG-SC-LOC-033-18-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will wait with your luggage and want to be told even if a change is unavailable. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-18-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-18-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 確認に行って、結果をお伝えします。どうぞこちらでお待ちください、では失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-18-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will go and check, then tell you the result. Please wait here. Excuse me.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-19-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-19-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お持ちのパンは動物に与えず、おかばんにしまってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-19-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please put the bread you have into your bag rather than feeding it to the animals.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-19-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-19-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 子どもが動物にあげたいと言っていたので持ってきましたが、持参した食べ物は使えないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-19-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 子どもの希望で持参したパンを与えられない理解を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-19-001-SHARED-02.translation: I brought it because my child wanted to feed the animals. So we cannot use food we bring ourselves.
DLG-SC-LOC-033-19-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show that you understand you cannot feed the bread brought at your child's request. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-19-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-19-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 動物のためにも、職員の案内がない給餌はしないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-19-001-SHARED-03.translation: For the animals' sake as well, please do not feed them without staff guidance.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-19-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-19-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: パンはしまいましたので、参加できる給餌の体験があるか案内を聞いてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-19-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: パンを片づけて当日の給餌体験の有無を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-19-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have put the bread away. May I ask whether there is a feeding activity we can take part in?
DLG-SC-LOC-033-19-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Put the bread away and ask whether a feeding activity is available today. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-19-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-19-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 今日の実施状況を確認します。体験がある場合も、指定の物だけを使っていただきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-19-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check what is running today. Even if an activity is available, you may use only the designated food.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-19-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-19-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 子どもはまだ小さいので、参加できる年齢や付き添いの条件も知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-19-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 幼い子どもの参加年齢と付き添い条件を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-19-001-SHARED-06.translation: My child is still young, so I would also like to know the participation age and accompanying-adult requirements.
DLG-SC-LOC-033-19-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask the participation age and accompanying-adult conditions for your young child. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-19-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-19-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 実施の案内に参加条件が載っているか、一緒に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-19-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us check together whether the activity information lists the participation conditions.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-19-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-19-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 条件に合わなければ参加せず、離れた所から動物を見るだけにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-19-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 条件に合わなければ体験に参加せず離れて見ると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-19-001-SHARED-08.translation: If we do not meet the conditions, we will not take part and will just watch the animals from a distance.
DLG-SC-LOC-033-19-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decide that if the conditions are not met, you will not join the activity and will watch from a distance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-19-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-19-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、見学中も柵の中へ手や物を入れないよう、お子さまにお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-19-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Please also tell your child not to put hands or objects through the fence while watching.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-19-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-19-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 体験の有無と条件を確かめ、参加できない場合は柵の外で子どもと見学します。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-19-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 体験条件を確認し不可なら柵の外で子どもと見学する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-19-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will check whether the activity is available and its conditions. If we cannot take part, I will watch with my child from outside the fence.
DLG-SC-LOC-033-19-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the activity conditions and say that if participation is not possible, you will watch with your child outside the fence. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-19-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-19-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 案内をお渡しします。どうぞ、ご家族で園内をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-19-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will give you the information. Please enjoy the park with your family.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-20-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-20-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日の搬入は、指定の通路を使います。始める前に気になることはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-20-001-SHARED-01.translation: We will use the designated passage for today's delivery. Is there anything concerning you before we start?

DLG-SC-LOC-033-20-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-20-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 通路の曲がり角に資材が置かれていて、台車が通れそうにないので、まだ搬入を始めていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-20-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 通路の資材で台車が通れず搬入を始めていないことを報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-20-001-SHARED-02.translation: Materials have been left at a corner in the passage, and it does not look as though the cart can get through, so I have not started bringing things in yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-033-20-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report that materials block the cart's route and you have not started the delivery. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-20-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-20-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 始めずに知らせてくれて助かりました。現場の図で、塞がっている位置を示してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-20-001-SHARED-03.translation: Thank you for telling us without starting. Please show the blocked location on the site plan.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-20-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-20-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 倉庫の出口から曲がったこの角です、資材は誰の物かわからず触っていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-20-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 現場図で倉庫出口の曲がり角を示し資材には触っていないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-20-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is this corner after turning from the warehouse exit. I do not know whose materials they are and have not touched them.
DLG-SC-LOC-033-20-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Point out the corner by the warehouse exit on the site plan and say that you have not touched the materials. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-20-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-20-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらで責任者へ確認しますので、勝手に移動したり別の区域を通ったりしないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-20-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check with the person in charge. Please do not move them yourself or pass through another area without permission.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-20-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-20-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 遠回りの道なら通れそうですが、指示が出るまで台車を待機場所に置いておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-20-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 無断で迂回せず指示まで台車を待機場所に置くと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-20-001-SHARED-06.translation: It looks as if a longer route might work, but I will leave the cart in the waiting area until instructions are given.
DLG-SC-LOC-033-20-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will not take an unauthorized detour and will leave the cart in the waiting area until instructed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-20-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-20-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そのまま待機してください。通路が使える状態になったあと、責任者が再開の指示を出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-20-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please remain on standby. After the passage is usable, the person in charge will give the instruction to resume.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-20-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-20-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 資材がなくなっても、自分で通れると判断せず、再開の指示を聞いてから動くのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-20-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 資材撤去後も責任者の再開指示を待つ理解を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-20-001-SHARED-08.translation: So even if the materials are removed, I should not decide on my own that I can pass. I should wait for the instruction to resume before moving.
DLG-SC-LOC-033-20-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm that you understand you must wait for the supervisor's instruction even after the materials are removed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-20-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-20-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、再開前には通路と周囲の作業も再確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-20-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Before resuming, we will recheck the passage and work going on around it too.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-20-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-20-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 今は搬入を止めたまま待機し、指示が出たら経路を確認してから再開します。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-20-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 搬入を停止したまま待機し指示後に経路を再確認して再開する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-20-001-SHARED-10.translation: For now, I will keep the delivery stopped and remain on standby. Once instructed, I will check the route before resuming.
DLG-SC-LOC-033-20-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Keep the delivery stopped while waiting, then recheck the route and resume after the instruction. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-20-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-20-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その手順でお願いします。待機場所でお待ちください、ではいったん失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-20-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please follow that procedure. Wait in the designated waiting area. Excuse me for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-21-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-21-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 通知が戻ってきたため、登録住所を確認したいと伺っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-21-001-SHARED-01.translation: I understand you would like to check your registered address because a notice was returned to us.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-21-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-21-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 引っ越しの手続きはしましたが、銀行には旧住所のまま登録されているようです。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-21-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 銀行の登録住所が引っ越し前のままになっていることを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-21-001-SHARED-02.translation: I completed the moving procedures, but it seems the bank still has my old address registered.
DLG-SC-LOC-033-21-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the bank's registered address is still your pre-move address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-21-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-21-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 口座の住所は、こちらでも変更の手続きが必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-21-001-SHARED-03.translation: You also need to complete a change procedure here for the account address.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-21-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-21-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 新しい住所が載った本人確認書類を持ってきましたが、これで手続きを始められますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-21-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 新住所の本人確認書類で申請を始められるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-21-001-SHARED-04.translation: I brought an identity document showing my new address. Can I start the procedure with this?
DLG-SC-LOC-033-21-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can begin the application with your identification showing the new address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-21-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-21-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 書類を拝見して、使えるか確認しますので、申請欄に新住所をご記入ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-21-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will look at the document to check whether it can be used. Please write your new address in the application section.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-21-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-21-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 建物名の下に部屋番号を書き忘れましたので、訂正の方法を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-21-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 申請欄で抜けた部屋番号の訂正方法を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-21-001-SHARED-06.translation: I forgot to write the room number below the building name. Please tell me how to correct it.
DLG-SC-LOC-033-21-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask how to correct the omitted room number in the application. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-21-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-21-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この欄に書き足していただき、最後に住所全体を読み合わせましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-21-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please add it in this space, and at the end we will read through the full address together.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-21-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-21-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 部屋番号は三〇二ですので、訂正した欄も含めて読み上げていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-21-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 三〇二号室を含めた住所の読み合わせを依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-21-001-SHARED-08.translation: The room number is three-oh-two. Could you read it aloud, including the corrected section?
DLG-SC-LOC-033-21-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to check the address aloud, including room three-oh-two. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-21-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-21-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 三〇二号室ですね。返送された通知については、再送の扱いを確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-21-001-SHARED-09.translation: Room three-oh-two, correct. I will check how we can resend the returned notice.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-21-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-033-21-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 再送が必要なことも記録していただき、今日は住所変更の申請をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-21-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 返送通知の再送希望を記録して住所変更を申し込む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-21-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please also record that it needs to be resent. Today, I would like to submit the change-of-address application.
DLG-SC-LOC-033-21-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask for the request to resend the returned notice to be recorded, and apply for the address change. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-033-21-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-033-21-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 住所変更と再送の希望をお預かりしましたので、確認結果は別途お伝えします。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-033-21-001-SHARED-11.translation: We have received your address-change application and request for resending. We will notify you separately of the result of our checks. Please take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 改札を出る前に、行き先を伺ってもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Before you leave the ticket gates, may I ask where you are going?

DLG-SC-LOC-034-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人と南口で会う約束です。北口の表示しか見つからなくて、こちらで合っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 南口への方向を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am meeting a friend at the south exit. I can only find signs for the north exit. Am I going the right way here?
DLG-SC-LOC-034-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask the direction to the south exit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらは北側です。南側へは連絡通路を使います。お友達は南口のどの辺りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: This is the north side. Use the connecting passage to reach the south side. Whereabouts at the south exit is your friend?

DLG-SC-LOC-034-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: バス乗り場の近くと言っていました。乗り場がいくつもあるなら、番号を聞いたほうがいいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 待ち合わせの乗り場番号を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: They said near the bus boarding area. If there are several bays, I should ask for the bay number.
DLG-SC-LOC-034-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Check the boarding-bay number for your meeting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そうですね。番号がわかれば、通路を渡った後の方向も絞れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. Knowing the number will also help narrow down which way to go after crossing the passage.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今聞けました。三番乗り場です。階段を使わずに行く道を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 階段を避ける経路を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have just asked. It is bay three. Please tell me a route without stairs.
DLG-SC-LOC-034-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for a route that avoids stairs. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この先のエレベーターで上がり、南口の表示に沿って進んでください。降りた所に案内図があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Go up in the elevator ahead and follow the south-exit signs. There is a map where you come down.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 南側に降りてから三番乗り場を探すんですね。待ち合わせに遅れるので、通路を渡り始めたと連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 南側の案内図で確認する順序を復唱する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: So after coming down on the south side, I look for bay three. I will be late for our meeting, so I will let my friend know I have started crossing the passage.
DLG-SC-LOC-034-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Repeat the sequence of checking the map on the south side. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。案内図でも迷ったら、近くの係員に三番乗り場と伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. If you are still unsure after looking at the map, tell a nearby staff member you want bay three.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。まずエレベーターへ行きます。急いでいても走らないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 最初に向かう場所と安全な移動を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I will go to the elevator first. Even though I am in a hurry, I will be careful not to run.
DLG-SC-LOC-034-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say where you will go first and that you will move safely. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お気をつけて。お友達と無事に会えるといいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Take care. I hope you meet your friend without trouble.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 撮影前のご相談ですね。どのような写真をお考えですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like advice before taking photographs. What sort of photo are you planning?

DLG-SC-LOC-034-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 建物を背景に家族を撮りたいです。いま人が集まっている所でも大丈夫でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族写真の場所を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to photograph my family with the building behind them. Is it all right to do it where people are gathering now?
DLG-SC-LOC-034-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about a location for a family photo. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今日はそこを通路として空けています。少し離れた空いている所をご案内できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: We are keeping that area clear as a passage today. I can show you an open spot a little farther away.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: では、通行を妨げない場所を選びたいです。三脚は立てず、手で持って撮ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 通路を避け手持ち撮影を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Then I would like to choose somewhere that does not obstruct people. I will hold the camera rather than set up a tripod.
DLG-SC-LOC-034-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Choose handheld photography away from the passage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その撮り方なら場所を取らずに済みますね。ただ、周囲の方が写る場合にもご配慮ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: That will take up less space. Please also be considerate if people around you appear in the picture.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 知らない方の顔が入ったら、その写真は公開しないことにします。撮る向きも変えたほうがいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 他人の顔の公開を避ける方針を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: If someone I do not know has their face in the photo, I will not publish it. Should I change the direction I shoot in too?
DLG-SC-LOC-034-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will avoid publishing other people's faces. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。こちらの方向なら通路が背景に入りにくいです。静かに過ごされている方にも声をかけずに済みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. From this direction, the passage is less likely to be in the background. You will also avoid needing to call out to people spending time quietly.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 家族にはここで待ってもらいます。建物だけの写真も、この位置から一枚撮りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家族の待機と建物撮影を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will have my family wait here. I would also like to take one photo of just the building from this position.
DLG-SC-LOC-034-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that your family will wait and that you will photograph the building. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その前に、足元の境界表示を確認してください。表示の内側には入らないでくださいね。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Before that, please check the boundary marked at your feet. Do not enter the area inside the markings.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この線を越えずに撮って、終わったらすぐ場所を空けます。教えてくださってありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 境界を守り撮影後に移動すると約束する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will take the photos without crossing this line and leave the space straight away when finished. Thank you for explaining.
DLG-SC-LOC-034-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Promise to respect the boundary and move away after taking photos. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞ周りに気をつけて。良い一日をお過ごしください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please be mindful of those around you. Have a good day.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お父様が少しお疲れのようですが、休める場所をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Your father looks a little tired. Are you looking for somewhere to rest?

DLG-SC-LOC-034-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。父は長く歩けないので、入口に戻る途中で座れる道がいいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 父の歩行制限と休憩希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. My father cannot walk for long, so we would like a route where he can sit down on the way back to the entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-034-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain your father's walking limitation and wish to rest. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この学習用の園内図では、橋を渡る道より池の手前で戻る道が短いですよ。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: On this educational park map, the path that turns back before the pond is shorter than the one crossing the bridge.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 短い道にします。池の手前のベンチまで、坂はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 短い道の坂を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: We will take the shorter route. Are there any slopes on the way to the bench before the pond?
DLG-SC-LOC-034-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask about slopes on the shorter route. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 平らな道ですが、途中に小さな段差があります。こちらの迂回路なら段差を避けられます。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: It is level, but there is a small step along the way. This detour avoids the step.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 父は杖を使っているので、迂回路を通ります。入口へ戻る矢印もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 杖に合わせた迂回路を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: My father uses a cane, so we will take the detour. Are there arrows showing the way back to the entrance too?
DLG-SC-LOC-034-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose the detour to suit your father's cane use. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 分かれ道に入口方向の矢印があります。ベンチを過ぎたら左の表示をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: There is an arrow toward the entrance at the fork. After passing the bench, look at the sign on the left.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 休憩したあと左へ進みます。水を買える所は帰り道にありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 帰路と飲料購入場所を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: We will rest and then go left. Is there somewhere to buy water on the way back?
DLG-SC-LOC-034-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check the return route and where to buy drinks. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この案内図には入口付近の売店が載っています。営業中かは戻った時に確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: This map shows a shop near the entrance. Please check whether it is open when you get back.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 手持ちの水を先に飲んでもらい、買えるかは入口で確かめます。無理に池を一周するのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 手持ちの水を使い散歩を短縮する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will have him drink the water we have first, and check at the entrance whether we can buy more. We will not push ourselves to go all the way around the pond.
DLG-SC-LOC-034-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Use the water you have and shorten the walk. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それが安心ですね。お父様のペースで、お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: That sounds reassuring. Please return safely at your father's pace.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お連れ様とはぐれましたか。案内図で現在地をご確認いただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you become separated from your companion? You can check your current location on the map.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 友人は城の入口にいるそうですが、私は売店の前です。入口というだけでは同じ場所か判断できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 入口の曖昧さを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: My friend says they are at the castle entrance, but I am in front of the shop. Just saying “the entrance” does not tell me whether we mean the same place.
DLG-SC-LOC-034-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain why “the entrance” is ambiguous. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 門が二つ描かれていますね。友人の方に、近くの案内板の文字を聞いてみてはどうでしょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: There are two gates shown. Why not ask your friend what the nearby information board says?

DLG-SC-LOC-034-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 聞いてみます。西門と書いてあるそうです。私がそこへ向かうより、共通の目印を決めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 友人の門名を確認し共通目印を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will ask. Apparently it says “West Gate.” Rather than go there myself, I would like to choose a shared landmark.
DLG-SC-LOC-034-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm your friend's gate name and ask for a shared landmark. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: それならこの案内所前はいかがですか。両方の門から案内所の表示をたどれます。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then how about in front of this information center? From either gate, you can follow signs for the information center.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 案内所の正面で、赤い帽子をかぶって待つと伝えます。ここからはどちらへ進みますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 服装と集合場所を指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will say I will wait in front of the information center wearing a red hat. Which way should I go from here?
DLG-SC-LOC-034-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Specify your clothing and meeting point. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 売店を背にして右へ進んでください。建物の裏側ではなく、受付のある正面です。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: With your back to the shop, go right. It is the front with reception, rather than behind the building.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 正面の受付側ですね。友人の電池が少ないので、到着予定を一度だけ送っておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 案内所の正面と連絡回数を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: The front, on the reception side, then. My friend's phone battery is low, so I will send my expected arrival time just once.
DLG-SC-LOC-034-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the front of the information center and how often you will contact your friend. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お二人が動き続けると行き違いやすいので、先に着いた方はそこで待つと決めるといいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: If both of you keep moving, you can easily miss each other. It is best to agree that whoever arrives first will wait there.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 私が先に着いたら動かずに待ちます。五分ほどで着くと送信できました。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 先着者が動かない約束をする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: If I get there first, I will stay and wait. I have sent that I will arrive in about five minutes.
DLG-SC-LOC-034-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Agree that whoever arrives first will stay put. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 合流場所が決まってよかったです。お気をつけて、いってらっしゃい。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I am glad you have chosen a meeting point. Take care on your way.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 初めての受診ですね。予約は取っていらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is your first visit. Do you have an appointment?

DLG-SC-LOC-034-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 予約はありません。昨日から喉が痛く、今朝は熱も出ました。こちらで受付できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 予約なしの症状を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I do not. My throat has hurt since yesterday, and I developed a fever this morning too. Can I register here?
DLG-SC-LOC-034-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you have no appointment and describe your symptoms. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まず受診先と本日の受付状況を確認します。息苦しさや水分が取れないなどの症状はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: First, we will check the appropriate service and today's registration availability. Do you have symptoms such as difficulty breathing or being unable to drink fluids?

DLG-SC-LOC-034-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 息苦しくはなく、水は飲めています。体温は今朝三十八度でした。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 体温と飲水状況を答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I am not short of breath and can drink water. My temperature was thirty-eight degrees this morning.
DLG-SC-LOC-034-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State your temperature and whether you can drink water. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: わかりました。受付担当に確認する間、こちらでお待ちください。保険資格を確認できるものはお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Understood. Please wait here while I check with reception. Have you brought something that verifies your insurance eligibility?

DLG-SC-LOC-034-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 資格確認書を持っています。紹介状はないのですが、その点も先に確認していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 資格確認書と紹介状の不足を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have an insurance eligibility confirmation document. I do not have a referral letter. Could you check that point first too?
DLG-SC-LOC-034-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Discuss your insurance eligibility document and lack of a referral letter. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。紹介状がない場合の扱いも含めて確認します。お名前と連絡先をこの用紙にお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. We will also check what happens without a referral. Please write your name and contact information on this form.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 漢字の名前がないので、在留カードと同じアルファベットで書いてもいいでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人確認と名前の表記を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I do not have a name written in kanji. May I write it in the same Latin letters as on my residence card?
DLG-SC-LOC-034-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask about identity verification and how to write your name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 照合できる表記を受付で確認しますので、カードを見せてください。まだ受診できると確定したわけではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Reception will check which spelling can be matched, so please show your card. It has not yet been confirmed that you can be seen.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-034-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: わかりました。用紙を記入して待ちます。待っている間に息苦しくなったら、すぐお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 受付確認を待ち症状変化を報告すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will fill in the form and wait. If I start having difficulty breathing while waiting, I will tell you immediately.
DLG-SC-LOC-034-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will wait for registration confirmation and report any change in symptoms. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-034-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-034-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、変化があれば遠慮なく声をかけてください。では、失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-034-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. If anything changes, please do not hesitate to speak to us. Excuse me.
